Name: Count
Description: Sets the number of main contour lines to generate. Higher values create more elevation bands across the terrain.

Name: Subdivision
Description: Controls the number of subdivisions between main contour lines, adding finer detail and intermediate lines.

Name: Accuracy
Description: Adjusts the precision of contour line placement. Higher accuracy produces more exact lines that closely follow the terrain's elevation.

Name: Lines
Description: Group containing parameters for customizing the appearance and properties of contour lines.

Name: Line Intensity
Description: Controls the brightness or opacity of the main contour lines, making them more or less prominent in the output.

Name: Sub Intensity
Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the subdivision lines, which are the finer lines between main contours.

Name: Line Thickness
Description: Specifies the thickness of the contour lines. Higher values produce bolder, wider lines.
